predictions.headToHead: First top-flight meeting between these two clubs in 25 years — Coventry's promotion ends a long gap in this fixture.
predictions.narrative: Arsenal open their title defense at home against a Coventry side that won the Championship by 11 points under Frank Lampard, returning to the top flight for the first time in a quarter-century.
predictions.prediction: William Saliba is ruled out for an extended period following a World Cup back injury, and Jurrien Timber is still working back from his own rehab — a real, specific vulnerability at center-back for a season opener. Bruno Guimarães' arrival gives Arteta a genuine midfield upgrade to lean on. The gap in overall quality clearly favors Arsenal, but the defensive absences are worth tracking, particularly if Coventry get numbers forward on the counter early.
predictions.keyPlayer: Bruno Guimarães (Arsenal) — full debut off the back of a £75m move

predictions.headToHead: Just one previous meeting between these two clubs — and it was a classic. In the 2024/25 Champions League quarter-final, PSG won the first leg 3-1, then Aston Villa staged a stunning comeback in the second leg, winning 3-2 and clawing back from 5-1 down on aggregate before PSG held on to advance 5-4 on aggregate.
predictions.narrative: European club football's traditional season-opener pits the reigning Champions League winners against the Europa League champions at a neutral venue in Salzburg, Austria. PSG are chasing back-to-back Super Cups — only Real Madrid (2016, 2017) have managed that in the modern era. Aston Villa are playing for their first Super Cup since 1982, when they beat Barcelona, and their first European trophy since a famous run to this year's Europa League title.
predictions.prediction: PSG arrive with the sharper recent form — their last five matches include real competitive fixtures (Ligue 1 wins, a Champions League final), while Aston Villa's last five have been entirely pre-season friendlies, conceding 10 goals across that stretch including a 2-1 loss to Bayern Munich just five days before this final. That gap in competitive sharpness favors PSG heading in. But the history between these two sides is a real caution against assuming an easy PSG night — their only previous meeting produced one of the most dramatic comebacks in recent Champions League memory, and Villa have shown they're capable of turning a game on its head against this exact opponent. Reigning Ballon d'Or winner Ousmane Dembélé carries PSG's attacking threat, while Morgan Rogers, named the Europa League's best player this season, is the one Villa player capable of matching that quality individually.

predictions.headToHead: This is Alexander Isak's first competitive appearance against Newcastle since his £125m move to Liverpool last summer.
predictions.narrative: The marquee fixture of the opening weekend. Liverpool enter under new head coach Andoni Iraola, following Arne Slot's exit after last season.
predictions.prediction: Liverpool's real depth concerns under a new manager, Isak's psychological test facing his old club, and what it all means heading into the season. Liverpool have depth concerns particularly at center-back and in wide areas, with Hugo Ekitike still recovering from an Achilles injury and a deal for PSG's Bradley Barcola still being pursued.
predictions.keyPlayer: Alexander Isak (Liverpool) — facing his former club for the first time
